## Summary
- Settings > Website > "Iframe url" now has a language dropdown (nl/fr/en/de) next to it, defaulting to the language the owner currently sees the UI in. Changing it updates the readonly URL field, the "Openen" link and the "Kopieer" button live, appending `?lang=` — the parameter `WebsiteController::setLanguage()` already reads on `index`, `detail` and `search`.
- Fixed a bug found while verifying that mechanism: `WebsiteController::setLanguage()`'s "the session already holds a language" branch compared a string code (`'fr'`) against an int-keyed array, so it was always false — any request that didn't repeat `?lang=` (the search form, a second visit to `index`) silently reset the visitor's chosen language back to the dealer's own default. Fixed and covered by a regression test.
- Filed a finding (`docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-iframe-taal-overleeft-contact-niet.md`) for a related, still-open gap: `WebsiteController::contact()` never calls `setLanguage()` at all and relies solely on `SetLangMiddleware`, which carries the same kind of string/int mismatch in its own fallback — so the contact modal still renders in Dutch regardless of the chosen language. Left unfixed here (different file, out of this PR's scope).
- Extended rule P2-10 with R P2-10.22 describing the new picker.

## Test plan
- `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Settings|Website|CompiledViews|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity'` → 100 tests, 427 assertions, all green (includes the new `SettingsWebsiteIframeLanguageTest`, 4 tests: the tab renders all four languages with the current locale pre-selected, a request to the embed with `?lang=fr` renders in French, the detail link already forwards the language, and the language now survives a follow-up search request).
- Manual verification in the browser (Playwright) at 1440px and 390px: changing the dropdown updates the URL/Openen/Kopieer live; screenshots attached.
